help_stats_overview: The four colored cards at the top of the dashboard show the core data overview of the system:
help_stats_users: User Statistics: Shows the number of registered and imported users. Click to go to the user management page.
help_stats_exams: Exam Statistics: Shows the total number of exams and counts by status (Ongoing, Closed, Draft, Not Started).
help_stats_trainings: Training Statistics: Shows the total number of trainings, total sign-ins, and today's sign-ins.
help_stats_interviews: Interview Statistics: Shows the total number of interviews. Click to go to the interview management page.
help_exam_list_actions: Each row in the exam list provides complete exam management operations:
help_exam_push: Push: Set the exam validity period and notify candidates to take the exam.
help_exam_edit: Edit: Modify exam name, duration, reviewer, and questions (only editable in draft status).
help_exam_copy: Copy: Duplicate the entire exam (including questions) to create a new exam.
help_exam_delete: Delete: Supports soft delete (recoverable) and permanent delete.
help_exam_pdf: Batch Export PDF: Export all candidates' score reports (ZIP archive).
help_candidate_status: After selecting an exam, you can view and manage each candidate's exam status:
help_candidate_assign: Assign/Unassign: Assign or cancel exam assignments for candidates.
help_candidate_reset: Reset: Reset the candidate's exam status to allow retaking the exam.
help_candidate_score: View Score: Click details to see the candidate's answers.
help_export_exact: Exact Filter: Filter data precisely by country, training, exam, date, etc.
help_export_multi: Multi Filter: Support multi-select trainings and exams to export multiple reports at once.
help_create_training: Click the 'New Training' button to create a training, fill in the name, country, and validity period.
help_edit_training_name: Edit Name: Click the edit button in the row to modify the training name.
help_edit_training_time: Edit Validity: In edit mode, you can directly modify the start and end times.
help_training_country: Country: The country associated with the training determines which users can see it.
help_push_training: Click the 'Push' button to set the sign-in validity period and select the push target:
help_push_all: Push All: Notify all registered users with matching countries.
help_push_selected: Targeted Push: Select specific users for notification.
help_push_notification: Notification: Users will receive an email notification after push.
help_header_template: Set header information for the training sign-in sheet (bilingual), with different templates for different countries.
help_header_fields: Header Fields: Training name, project number, venue, language, target audience, organizing department, etc.
help_header_country: Country Template: Click 'Header Input' to set an independent template for a specific country.
help_view_status: Click the training name or 'Attendees' button to view the sign-in status of all users in that training.
help_status_filter: Status Filter: Filter by statuses such as Signed, Pending, Need Re-sign, etc.
help_status_actions: Actions: Assign training, unassign, force re-sign, etc.
help_training_photos: Click the photo icon in the training row to enter the photo management interface.
help_photo_upload: Upload: Select a training and upload photos. Date watermark is automatically added.
help_photo_view: View: Photos are grouped by training with support for full-screen preview.
help_photo_delete: Delete: Admins can delete any photo; normal users can only delete their own uploads.
help_training_binding: Click the '▶' expand icon in the training row to manage exams bound to this training.
help_binding_add: Bind Exam: Select an exam to bind to the training. After signing in, users will be automatically assigned the bound exam.
help_binding_config: Configuration: Set pass score, auto-assign, and required status.
help_binding_reassign: Reassign: Reassign exams to users who have signed in but haven't been assigned yet.
help_create_exam: There are two ways to create an exam:
help_import_word: Import Word: Upload a Word document in the required format for automatic parsing.
help_copy_exam: Copy Exam: Copy from an existing exam to quickly create a new one.
help_status_draft: Draft: Exam is being created, not pushed, all content can be edited.
help_status_created: Not Started: Pushed but not yet started, candidates cannot enter.
help_status_active: Ongoing: Exam is in progress, candidates can enter and answer.
help_status_closed: Closed: Exam has ended, questions cannot be modified, scores can be viewed.
help_exam_push_detail: Click the 'Push' button to set exam time and reviewer:
help_exam_time: Validity Period: Set the exam start and end time.
help_exam_candidates: Candidates: Select the list of candidates to push (supports search and filter).
help_exam_scores: Click 'Details' to view the candidate score list, supporting:
help_score_detail: View Answer Details: View each question's answer and score.
help_export_pdf: Export PDF: Export individual or batch candidate score reports.
help_force_reset: Force Reset: Allow candidates to retake the exam (retains original scores).
help_deleted_exams: Click the 'Deleted Exams' button to view soft-deleted exam records.
help_restore_exam: Restore: Restore a soft-deleted exam to normal status.
help_permanent_delete_exam: Permanent Delete: Permanently delete an exam (only when no associated score records exist).
help_add_user: Two ways to add users are supported:
help_add_manual: Manual Add: Fill in user information and set role and permission scope.
help_import_users: Batch Import: Download the template, fill it in, and upload to import users.
help_user_search: Search/Filter: Filter users by name, email, country, warehouse, etc.
help_user_export: Export Excel: Export the user list under current filter conditions.
help_user_reset_pwd: Reset Password: Generate a new password and send it to the user's email.
help_user_resign: Mark Resign/Rehire: Manage user employment status; resigned users cannot log in.
help_role_user: Normal User: Can only take exams and sign in to trainings.
help_role_admin: Admin: Can manage users, trainings, exams, etc., for specified countries.
help_role_super_admin: Super Admin: Has all permissions and can create admins.
help_role_developer: Developer: Has the highest permissions and can access all features and data.
help_deleted_users: Click the 'Deleted Users' button to view soft-deleted user records.
help_restore_user: Restore: Restore a user to normal status.
help_interview_select_exam: Select Exam: Choose an existing exam as the question source.
help_interview_select_users: Select Users: Choose the trainees to participate in the interview.
help_interview_question_count: Question Count: Set the number of interview questions for each trainee.
help_interview_preview: Preview: Preview the interview questions for each trainee.
help_force_interview: Initiate a force interview for users who have not completed the interview:
help_force_trigger: Trigger: Click the 'Force Interview' button in the interview details page.
help_force_effect: Effect: The user will receive a new interview task with a 2-hour validity period.
help_force_batch: Batch Force: Supports initiating force interviews for multiple users at once.
help_view_interview_results: Click the 'Details' button in the interview list to view:
help_interview_answer_detail: Answer Details: View the answer details of each user.
help_interview_stats: Statistics: Shows the number of questions answered and accuracy rate.
help_interview_resample: Resample: Regenerate interview questions for a user.
help_wh_add: Add Warehouse: Enter warehouse code, name, and type. Country code is automatically extracted from the warehouse ID.
help_wh_delete: Delete Warehouse: Supports soft delete (recoverable) and permanent delete (requires no associated users).
help_wh_import: Batch Import: Download the template, fill it in, and import warehouse information.
help_wh_country: The first 2 characters of the warehouse code are automatically recognized as the country code (e.g., NP001 → Nepal). The system automatically assigns users based on the warehouse's country.
help_privacy_new: Create Version: Enter version number, title, content, and changelog.
help_privacy_edit: Edit Version: Modify existing version content (non-active versions only).
help_privacy_activate: Activate Version: After activation, all users need to re-confirm the privacy statement.
help_privacy_delete: Delete Version: Only non-active versions can be deleted.
help_privacy_status: Click the statistics cards to view user confirmation status:
help_privacy_confirmed: Confirmed: Users who have confirmed the current privacy statement.
help_privacy_unconfirmed: Unconfirmed: Users who have not yet confirmed the current privacy statement.
help_privacy_rate: Confirmation Rate: Shows the confirmation percentage for the current version.
help_photo_select_training: Select Training: Choose the training from the dropdown list to upload photos.
help_photo_select_files: Select Files: Supports selecting from gallery or taking photos directly.
help_photo_watermark: Watermark: Automatically adds date and training name watermark to the bottom left of photos.
help_photo_grid: Photo Wall: Photos are grouped by training, supports expand/collapse.
help_photo_filter: Filter: Filter photos by training name or quarter.
help_photo_preview: Preview: Click to view full-screen photos with previous/next navigation.
help_footer: Click the table of contents on the left to jump quickly
